vendored.name: ponytail
vendored.notes: Source repo has no .claude-plugin/plugin.json (uses a root-level plugin.json + plugin.yaml for a different, multi-platform packaging convention) -- a minimal .claude-plugin/plugin.json wrapper was authored fresh for this vendored copy (not a patch to skill content). commands/ (TOML format, not Claude Code's .md convention) and hooks/ were not vendored -- unvalidated mechanisms; the plugin_directories -> skill-loading path is what Phase A0 actually confirmed works. ponytail-mcp/ (a bundled MCP server) was also not vendored -- flagged as a future enhancement, not validated here.

vendored.name: caveman
vendored.notes: Only the caveman skill itself was vendored, per explicit direction -- the source repo is a large monorepo (browser extension, proxy server, compression engine, MCP server, multiple other caveman-* skills). LICENSING.md confirms skills/ is MIT while the engine/proxy/browse/mcp components are BSL-1.1 -- vendoring only the skill keeps this cleanly within the MIT-licensed surface. No .claude-plugin/plugin.json in source; wrapper authored fresh, same reasoning as ponytail.
